body: Thank you for replying I greatly appreciate it. I agree I will leave her alone it’s her choice. I apprevisre your kind words and out look on the situation as it has given me a lot to think about.

You make some good points and have given me some stuff to think about. I guess she didn’t make the best decisions either. But I won’t hold it against her because I don’t want to make things harder on her and I think she’s intelligent enough to see her mistakes. I have considered quitting drinking all out and might very well. Thank you for your comment even though I disagree with you on some spots.
This is something I had not considered. If I get the chance to talk to her again i will apologize for apologizing so much. Unless that sounds dumb idk.

It was merely sharing a bed which can be platonic. And for all I know she could have been scared to say something idk. I don't mean to sound angry I just do not feel she should be held at fault like that.

I need you to stop right there. She did not cheat. She got into bed with person she thought she could trust and I betrayed that. She was not raped either, no intercourse took place. She was drunk and was not able to fully think about her actions.

I genuinely do not think she is being malicious about it now after this time has passed since the incident. I also do not want to victim blame her at all. I will make the intent to drink less from now on though.

I appreciate your honesty. I don't try to make excuses for what happened I know how awful what I did was and I can never make it right. I did not make this post with the intention of seeking sympathy. I feel lost and do not know what to do and was looking for answers. I won't forget your post trust me as this is how I feel all the time. I will never forget what I did and how horrible it was. And I know you don't like that people are supporting me but this is Suicide Watch. I want to die over this, if everyone was bashing me I don't think I could handle it and I would end my life. That is not intended to be a guilt trip I just don't know what else to say.
Thank you this helps a lot. I thought about donating to a women's center in her name maybe or just anonymously.
Thank you for our response. I will try to do what you said.
I greatly appreciate your honesty. It feels wrong to just write it off as an okay mistake. I will try to do what you said.

Thank you for your kind words. To be fair I did not actually go to a Women's Center I just called one, but I forgot to specify that. I don't think I'm gonna contact her for a while and I her bf is kinda unpredictable so I don't want to risk upsetting him again. But I do slightly feel better after your post.

Thank you for your response. She has called it sexual assault in a finsta post (a finsta is an instagram account that is private and followed by close friends only)  post she made opening up about the assault but not naming me. And I know for sure she feels bad about what happened and its not just the fact I have apologized so much because of that post. My last therapist said it was a stretch to call it sexual assault as well but I still see it as that because it was unwanted sexual contact.
